summary.goal: Allow plan authors to submit a draft for portfolio/reviewer review
summary.context: Submit is a coordination signal - 'this is ready for review'. The plan moves from working draft to submitted state but remains editable until approved.

acceptance_criteria.description: Submit button visible on draft plans
Submit shows confirmation dialog with summary
Plan status changes to 'submitted' after submit
UI shows who submitted and when
Author can still edit after submit (until approved)
Reviewers are notified (if notification system exists)

steps.title: Add Submit button to plan toolbar
steps.description: Submit button visible when viewing draft plan. Disabled for non-draft versions.

steps.title: Create submit confirmation dialog
steps.description: Dialog showing plan summary and asking for confirmation before submit.

acceptance_criteria.description: Dialog shows plan title, goal, step count

steps.title: Call submit API endpoint
steps.description: Connect Submit button to POST /plans/:id/versions/:v/submit API.

steps.title: Display submitted status in UI
steps.description: Show 'Submitted' badge on plan, with submitter and timestamp.

steps.title: Maintain edit capability after submit
steps.description: Ensure editing still works after submit (until approved).

acceptance_criteria.description: Note that edits may require re-review
